messages.subject: Confidential Executive Profile | ESG, External Affairs & Cross-Border Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Carol,

The Inzito Partnership's work on senior executive and board appointments for global organisations aligns with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where major investment, responsible development, institutional trust and cross-border execution intersect. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
